findings.zh: 从感知机、SVM 与 boosting，到深度表征、正则化、对比学习与泛化理论。
findings.en: From perceptrons and SVMs to deep representation learning, regularization, contrastive learning and generalization.

findings.zh: CNN、RNN、Transformer、GNN、ViT、MoE 与 Mamba 等主干网络演进。
findings.en: CNN, RNN, Transformer, GNN, ViT, MoE and Mamba lineages.

findings.zh: 优化器、混合精度、分布式训练、缩放法则与推理侧效率工程。
findings.en: Optimizers, mixed precision, distributed training, scaling laws and inference efficiency.

findings.zh: GAN、VAE、扩散、流匹配与潜空间生成式建模主线。
findings.en: GAN, VAE, diffusion, flow matching and latent generative modeling.

findings.zh: 预训练、对齐、RAG、开源大模型与推理时计算。
findings.en: Pre-training, alignment, RAG, open LLMs and test-time compute.

findings.zh: 检测分割、CLIP、多模态与视觉基础模型。
findings.en: Detection, segmentation, CLIP, multimodal and vision foundation models.

findings.zh: ReAct、工具调用、编程智能体与评测基准。
findings.en: ReAct, tool use, coding agents and evaluation benchmarks.

findings.zh: 强化学习、VLA、世界模型与机器人基础模型。
findings.en: RL, VLA, world models and robotics foundation models.
